name: EverWood® & Parkland® Blinds
description: EverWood® and Parkland® alternative wood and real wood blinds deliver the beauty of genuine wood with options designed to resist fading, warping, and bowing.

benefits.text:
Benefits of EverWood®  
Alternative Wood Blinds 
include exceptional  
durability, view-through 
and customizable 
light-control and privacy 
preferences.  
Heat and Humidity Resistance
EverWood blinds are extremely durable and can withstand heat  
and humidity in any climate. They are covered by Performance Plus™  
Protection, which ensures no fading, discoloring, warping or bowing.
More View-Through
Exceptionally sturdy slats require less support and afford broader views. 
Optimum Light Control and Privacy
Completely customize privacy and light-control preferences by tilting  
slats to any angle or position. 
Unique Finishes and Colors
Inspired by refined, custom cabinetry and furniture, EverWood® blinds 
offer the broadest finish and color selection on the market.

Benefits of Parkland® 
Wood Blinds include the 
beauty of real wood,  
plus custom finishes and 
many decorative options.
Optimum Light Control and Privacy
Tilt slats to any angle or position for customizable light-control and  
privacy settings.
Environmental Responsibility
Hunter Douglas donates a portion of every Parkland blind purchase  
to the Arbor Day Foundation®, which assists with the reforestation of 
U.S. forests and preservation of rainforest land internationally. 
Coordination With Home Décor
Parkland® blinds feature on-trend colors and finishes that perfectly  
complement the wood styles found in furniture, flooring, cabinetry  
and other home décor. 
Inherent Beauty of Natural Wood
Wood brings a touch of warmth and luxury to any space. Its unique  
grain patterns add depth and texture to the window.

Cordlock 
Blinds lock in place when the cord is pulled to raise or lower. 
Cord cleats prevent cord from dangling to the floor.
LiteRise 
This cordless system lifts and lowers blinds with the touch of a finger.
SimpleLift™
Operate blinds by engaging a push-button, located on the bottom rail. 
This cordless system is ideal for homes with children or pets.  
(SimpleLift available with PowerView® Motorization)
Child Safety Labels on Corded Systems
These warning labels appear on window fashions with cords to make 
consumers aware of window cord hazards for children and pets.  
WARNING/ADVERTENCIA
Window Blind Cord Strangulation Risk
Window blinds with a damaged or loose  tension
device or retractable cord that fails to fully retract
pose a strangulation risk to children. To avoid this
potential strangulation risk, consider purchasing
cordless products or products with inaccessible cords.

product_details.text:
Burl Figures
Formed by irregular growth on a tree’s outer surface.
Mineral Deposits
Result of environmental factors affecting a tree’s development.
Pin Knots
Remnants of branches covered by the growth of new wood.
Grain Change
A place in the grain structure where a branch grew and caused  
growth rings to move in a different direction.
Tiger Striping
A grain structure caused by irregular growth due to temperature changes.
Flat Grain
A swirl pattern produced by cutting tangent to growth rings.
Distinct grain patterns  
and markings are  
common characteristics  
of authentic wood  
that can be found in  
Parkland® Wood Blinds. 
Each unique mark or  
pattern reveals the special 
beauty associated with  
a natural material.

2" Slat
For traditional view-through.
2½" Slat
For wider view-through to the outdoors.
Traditional Routed Blinds
Cords are routed through small holes in each slat.
de-Light™ Routless Design
Eliminates cord holes to block light for  
enhanced privacy.

Provide an accent for blinds and home décor.
